text:
maria: Heads-up — PM asks we decide the real-time contract for chat completions (transport + partial payload format). Priority: roadmap gating for Q2 launches. Customers with asks: fintech, docs search, mobile chat. Need a recommendation by EOD.

alex: My take — ship an HTTP-based event stream (SSE) as the MVP transport. Use a simple token/fragment-first delta format and emit an explicit end event with a stable finish code. Pros: works with CDNs/proxies, easier to QA. Cons: no multiplexing, not bidirectional.

sanjay: SSE is pragmatic for browsers and mobile proxies, but several enterprise customers asked for websockets for long-lived sessions and multiplexing. Also they want resume semantics. We should weigh infra cost vs customer needs.

kevin: Agree with stable finish codes. Proposal for codes: `stop` (natural end), `length` (max tokens), `cancel` (user/server cancel), `error` (internal error), `fallback` (served by lower-tier model). Keep them string constants.

kevin: Example SSE frame sketch:
```
event: chunk
data: {"seq":42,"type":"token","text":"hello"}

event: chunk
data: {"seq":43,"type":"token","text":" world"}

event: done
data: {"finish_code":"length","seq":44}
```

olivia: From SDK perspective we need helpers that emit token events and can rehydrate structured outputs (function/tool calls). If we standardize `tool_start`/`tool_chunk`/`tool_end` events, SDKs can map to streaming function calls easily.

maria: Draft launch criteria suggestion:
- Transport decision for GA (SSE MVP vs WS GA)
- SDKs (JS/Python) support token events + structured events
- Public spec + examples for mobile proxy configs
- Telemetry: token-level latencies + finish_code counts
- Canary with 2 customers and rollback plan

alex: @sanjay rough ops question — what is the incremental cost to support both SSE and WS at GA? Ballpark numbers are fine.

sanjay: Supporting both increases surface area: gateway and additional tests. We can share backend streaming logic, but we need a websocket gateway and monitoring. Ops+SRE overhead ~20% initial effort; ongoing slightly higher.

kevin: Customer feature requests to fold into spec: resume after disconnect (use `seq` + resume token), choice of payload shape (JSON-lines vs structured events), explicit backpressure or `stall` hints. I think resume token + monotonic seq is must-have.

maria: Scope negotiation: propose MVP = SSE only + seq numbers + `done` finish codes + resume token. Stretch goals: WS support, multiplexing, binary frames, advanced backpressure. Everyone ok?

olivia: :thumbsup: SSE MVP keeps SDK complexity low and speeds delivery.

alex: Edge case: tool responses may emit partial JSON — recommend separate `tool_*` event types so partial JSON across frames is explicit.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary started for `streaming-sse-mvp` -> infra-123

maria: Next steps — PM will write the spec doc with the contract details. @kevin can you author the event contract draft by EOD? @alex can you enumerate SDK tasks and estimated effort? I'll slot this into next sprint planning.
